LightningComponentBundle.description: Interactive map showing nearby accounts from a configurable origin point.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: Two-letter code - 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls the default card title, list subtitle, origin marker label, and the 'Open account' link in pin popups. Explicit values override.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty for dictionary default (‘Nearby Accounts’ / ‘Comptes à proximité’).

property.name: recordTypeName
property.label: Account RecordType DeveloperName (filter)
property.description: Leave empty to include all record types.

property.name: originMode
property.label: Origin mode
property.description: 'auto' = use the browser's geolocation (HTTPS required; user is prompted once). Falls back to the lat/lng below if denied or unavailable. 'manual' = always use the lat/lng below.

property.name: originLatitude
property.label: Origin latitude (fallback)
property.description: Decimal degrees. Used when 'manual' is selected or when geolocation is denied. Defaults to central Paris (11e).

property.name: originLabel
property.label: Origin marker label (override)
property.description: Leave empty for dictionary default (‘My location’ / ‘Ma position’).

property.name: priorityFirstMarker
property.label: Highlight the first account as priority (red pin)
